text:
jon-support: Escalating onboarding issue for ACCT-ACME77 — customer seeing repeated 500s during dataset ingestion step 3. Logged ~30 fails in last 2 hours. Renewal discussion in 6 weeks; customer already flagged as fragile. Need CS lead + SE engagement. Logs + repro below.
SupportBot: New incident created #INC-2026-1783 — pinged eng-oncall.
jon-support: repro: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/ingest -H 'Authorization: Bearer <redacted>' -d @payload.json` -> 500 `{"error":"kv_cache_timeout"}`
katie-onboard: saw this in onboarding run earlier, thought it was transient. Is this related to batching changes deployed yesterday?
drew-se: possible. We rolled batching tweak at 2123451000 for small payloads. Can you paste full request headers and sequence length?
jon-support: headers trimmed, sending full payload via DM. main failure pattern: kv_cache read timeout 120s then 500.
eng-oncall: looking, grabbing logs from gpu-node-47. Repro locally takes ~2/3 attempts.
maria-cs: thanks for the ping. This is definitely a renewal risk. I'll lead customer comms and enablement. @rachel-ae please advise on renewal tone.
rachel-ae: FYI, ACME has indicated potential switch if onboarding doesn't stabilize. We should prioritize a mitigation plan before next weekly exec sync.
maria-cs: Proposed comms plan — short internal war room + daily 30m sync with customer until resolved.
 - Day 0 (now): Ack to customer within 1h, explain we're investigating and provide ETA 3-6h.
 - Day 1: Provide mitigation: temporary throttling + rollback to prior batching profile if confirmed safe.
 - Ongoing: daily status updates to customer + shared timeline for fix + postmortem + credits if SLA breached.
maria-cs: Internal RACI:
 - CS lead: maria-cs (customer comms, renewal escalation)
 - SE: drew-se (technical owner, workaround)
 - Onboard: katie-onboard (runbook + enablement)
 - Eng: eng-oncall (root cause and patch)
jon-support: ok assigning priority P1 -> CS escalation. I'll update ticket and set follow-up reminders.
katie-onboard: I'll prepare step-by-step mitigation runbook and a short how-to doc for the customer (rollback instructions + monitoring checks).
maria-cs: Draft message to customer (please review):

"Hi Alex — thanks for flagging. We're actively investigating an ingestion failure affecting a subset of uploads. We've opened a priority incident, our engineers are debugging, and we expect an initial update within 3 hours. If helpful we can apply a temporary change to your ingestion profile to restore throughput while we work on a permanent fix. I'll follow up with a detailed plan in the next update. — Maria"

please :+1: or suggest edits.
drew-se: looks good. I'll prep rollback patch and smoke test plan.
eng-oncall: found suspect: async kv read path occasionally hangs on large prefix sets. Patch started in CI, ETA 6h for canary.
maria-cs: thanks. I'll send ack to customer now and schedule daily sync for 9am PST starting tomorrow.
rachel-ae: keep me posted, I can join customer call if needed.
jon-support: updated ticket: INC-2026-1783 -> linked to ACCT-ACME77, flagged renewal-risk. Reminders set.
maria-cs: closing internal thread here; will post status updates in #customer-updates/ACME. :thumbsup:
